camel_example: aliyun hbr CreateHanaRestore --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'cl-000fbrs5000000ka9w' --BackupPrefix COMPLETE_DATA_BACKUP_2022_05_02_15_39 --Mode RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME --DatabaseName TS2
description_en: Creates a restore job for an SAP HANA database
description_zh: 创建SAP HANA数据库恢复任务
kebab_example: aliyun hbr create-hana-restore --cluster-id cl-000fbrs5000000ka9w --database-name TS2 --biz-mode RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME --backup-prefix COMPLETE_DATA_BACKUP_2022_05_02_15_39 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHanaRestore

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the SAP HANA instance to be recovered
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to be restored
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The restore mode. Valid values:
RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT: Most recent time. Restores the database to the most recent available state based on backups.
RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME: Specific time. Restores the database to a specific point in time.
RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP: Specific backup. Restores the database to a specific database backup.
RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION: Log position. Restores the database to a specific log position
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式。
RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT： 最近时间，将数据库恢复到已备份的最近可用状态。
RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME：指定时间，将数据库恢复到特定时间点。
RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP：指定备份，将数据库恢复到指定的数据库备份。
RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION：日志位置，将数据库还原到指定日志位置
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the database. This parameter is valid only when the Mode parameter is set to RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME. The system restores the database to the state closest to this point in time
parameters.help_zh: 选择需要恢复到的时间点。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME恢复方式时有效，系统会将数据库恢复到离这个时间最近的状态
parameters.name: recovery_point_in_time

parameters.help_en: The log position. This parameter is valid only when the Mode parameter is set to RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION
parameters.help_zh: 日志位置，仅选择RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION恢复方式时有效
parameters.name: log_position

parameters.help_en: The ID of the volume to be restored. This parameter is valid only when the Mode parameter is set to RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION
parameters.help_zh: 要恢复的Volume ID。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION恢复方式时有效
parameters.name: volume_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to search for backups from the catalog. This parameter is valid only when the Mode parameter is set to RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP. If you do not use the catalog, you must specify a backup prefix, and Cloud Backup restores the database based on the backup prefix
parameters.help_zh: 是否从Catalog中查找备份。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP恢复方式时有效。如果不使用Catalog，需要指定一个备份前缀，云备份服务会根据备份前缀进行恢复
parameters.name: use_catalog

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a cross-instance restore
parameters.name: system_copy

parameters.help_en: The name of the source system. This parameter specifies the name of the source database to be restored, in the format of `source database name@SID`
parameters.help_zh: 源系统名。表示需要恢复的源数据库名，格式为`源数据库名@SID`
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the source SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: source_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to initialize the log area. If you do not want to restore the log segments that reside in the log area, set this parameter to false. After the restore job is complete, log entries are deleted from the log area
parameters.help_zh: 初始化日志区域，如果不想恢复驻留在日志区中的日志段，请选择false。恢复后, 日志条目将从日志区中删除
parameters.name: clear_log

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to check the availability of differential and log backups. If you enable this option, the system checks whether the required differential and log backups are available at the beginning of the restore job. If a differential or log backup is missing, the restore job stops before any data is changed
parameters.help_zh: 检查差异和日志备份可用性。开启此项后，在恢复开始时，系统会检查所需的差异备份和日志备份是否都可用。 如果缺少差异备份或日志备份，在更改数据之前会停止恢复
parameters.name: check_access

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use differential backups. Select this option if you want to perform a restore by using differential or incremental backups. If you choose to perform a restore without using differential or incremental backups, log backups are used for the restore
parameters.help_zh: 使用差异备份。如果您需要使用差异备份或增量备份执行恢复，请选择此选项。如果选择在不使用差异备份或增量备份的情况下执行恢复，则使用日志备份进行恢复
parameters.name: use_delta

parameters.help_en: The SidAdmin account, which is a system account created by SAP HANA
parameters.help_zh: SidAdmin，SAP HANA创建的一个系统账号
parameters.name: sid_admin

parameters.help_en: The client ID of the HANA master node
parameters.name: master_client_id

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The return message. The value successful is returned if the call succeeds, and an error message is returned if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

RestoreId.description_en: The ID of the restore job

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
